name: Mood Check

collect.prompt:
How are you feeling today? (one word or short phrase)

Only the class summary goes on the screen — never your individual answer. Not up for it today? Pass is always okay.

process.instruction: Summarize the overall mood of this class in 2-3 sentences. Note any patterns. Be warm and supportive.

recommendedFor: Quick temperature read before a hard lesson or after a tough day.
